item.tib: dbang drag 'bar ba me phreng me dpung drwa ba'i rgyud las zhi ba tshe ru sgrub ba mi shig g.yung drung 'bar ba'i gur khang
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa yis shing pho stag gi lor gsang bdag phyag rdor gnas chen rdo rje gsang brag nas gter du spyan drangs te slar dmar ser can zhes me mo sbrul gyi lor mdo gam zal mo sgang gi sa cha dbyibs klong smin grol nas shog ser la zhal bshus grub pa'i 'gro rnams g.yung drung lta bu'i dbang thob nas rgyal ba'i brtan (bstan) pa rin chen kun tu rgyas pa'i gyur cig/
